note: Evidence manifest for the preserved-scratchpad store itself. README.md is the writeup; the five tarballs are byte-copies of the PRODUCING sessions' ephemeral /tmp scratchpads. Pinning the archives here is what makes every tarball: entry in the sibling manifests trustworthy: those name individual members, this pins the archives whole, so a member that no manifest happens to name is still covered.

entries.note: Why these tarballs exist and what each maps to.
Preserved scratchpad of the tp=4 hinge package (commit 4d5dee14). Members are named by ../EVIDENCE.json.
Preserved scratchpad of the regime-mean leg-2 extension, n=311 (commit f9a3e5db). Members are named by ../runs/regime_mean_2026-08-21/EVIDENCE.json.

Preserved scratchpad of the regime-mean full draw, n=399 (commit cbc3c862). Holds the preregistration, the estimator and the TRUE 331-row raw that were never committed. Members are named by ../runs/regime_mean_2026-08-21/EVIDENCE.json.
Preserved scratchpad of the tp=8 dense hinge (commit 6f411981). Members are named by ../EVIDENCE.json.
Preserved scratchpad of the MoE-at-tp=8 package (commit e3068d21). Holds the only byte-level backing for the MoE arms. Members are named by ../EVIDENCE.json.
